name: Welcome home
summary: A countdown to someone coming home: a dotted route from where they are to a little house, the plane however many days out, and welcome-back jobs in the yard (airport pickup, first meal, the couch) that friends claim; the porch light warms with each one.
useWhen: home in 9 days, i miss real food
back from abroad next friday who's picking me up
countdown till im home for break
having fun in south america but home soon
plan for when calvin gets back
dontUseWhen: a party with a guest list and a host (use host-board)
rides for a whole group trip (use carpool)
someone who is already back (use congrats-dinner)

days.description: Days until they're home; 0 on the day

total.description: How long they've been away in days, to place the plane on the route
